checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified the fundamental semantic mismatch: the image depicts eyewear (sunglasses) while the target class 'sunglass' in this taxonomy refers to a burning glass/magnifying tool. The Router was accurate in marking geometry and functional checkpoints as failed or untestable due to this class conflict. I agree with all verdicts; the object is definitively not the target class.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified the severe fusion artifact on the forehead (severity 4). However, it underestimated the structural collapse of the main subject. The right lens (viewer's left) is not merely reflecting incoherently; it is geometrically malformed, appearing to melt into the cheek and lacking a defined rim structure. Additionally, the mouth area shows significant anatomical distortion (smearing/fusion of lips), which the Router missed entirely. The topology auditor's mask confirms boundary issues around the head/forehead region. These combined structural failures warrant a lower artifact score than the Router's initial assessment implies.
alignment_reasoning: Zero alignment with the specific 'burning glass' taxonomy. While the fine-grained classifier predicted 'sunglass', it conflated the eyewear definition with the tool definition. The image fails all critical geometry and function checkpoints for the target class.
artifact_reasoning: Severe fusion artifact on forehead (floating lens shape) confirmed by Router and topology auditor. Additional unflagged artifacts include melting/distortion of the left lens rim and anatomical smearing of the mouth. The image suffers from multiple structural collapses beyond just the forehead element.
key_defects: Semantic mismatch: Eyewear vs Burning Glass

Structural collapse of left lens rim (melting into face)
